add_paragraph: Jasmine leads the materials bench, where the lab grows its own composites: chitin from shellfish waste, bound by mycelium, pressed into sheets that behave a little like plywood and rot like a leaf.
The group's ==biodegradable polymer== work began as a way to stop shipping instrument housings to remote sites that nobody would ever collect. It has since grown its own life.
Jasmine runs the lab's material testing too — every sheet is measured for strength, water uptake and how long it takes a soil community to take it apart.
